outcome: Vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) success rate
finding: While oxytocin use during labor was associated with a lower risk of PPH, prolonged labor and later gestational age at delivery were identified as risk factors for fetal distress in women attempting VBAC.
mod_finding: Birth mode (normal delivery vs. operative vaginal delivery) was significantly associated with both PPH and fetal distress in VBAC cases.
